evidence.title: Keliru, Vaksin Covid-19 Mengandung Microchip yang Bisa ...
evidence.snippet_en: Tempo.co rated the claim "Vaksin Covid-19 mengandung microchip yang bisa menyalakan lampu" as "Keliru" (False), stating that COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips that can light up lamps.

evidence.title: Vaksin Covid-19 tidak mengandung microchip magnetik
evidence.snippet_en: Periksa Fakta rated the claim "Vaksin Covid-19 mengandung microchip magnetik" as "Salah" (False), concluding that COVID-19 vaccines do not contain magnetic microchips.

evidence.title: [Fakta atau Hoaks] Benarkah Bill Gates Bikin Vaksin Corona yang ...
evidence.snippet_en: Tempo.co rated the claim "Bill Gates membuat vaksin virus Corona Covid-19 yang dipasang microchip" as "Keliru" (False), indicating that Bill Gates did not create a COVID-19 vaccine with an implanted microchip.

evidence.title: Vaksin Covid-19 Mengandung Magnet dan Microchip, Mitos atau ...
evidence.snippet_en: Suara.com rated the claim "Vaksin Covid-19 Mengandung Magnet dan Microchip, Mitos atau Fakta?" as "Salah" (False), concluding that COVID-19 vaccines do not contain magnets and microchips.

evidence.title: Keliru, Konten tentang Pemasangan Microchip Melalui Vaksinasi di ...
evidence.snippet_en: Tempo.co rated the claim "Keliru, Konten tentang Pemasangan Microchip Melalui Vaksinasi di Indonesia" as "keliru" (False), stating that content about microchip implantation through vaccination in Indonesia is incorrect.

evidence.title: [Fakta atau Hoaks] Benarkah Vaksin Covid-19 Tanamkan Microchip ...
evidence.snippet_en: Tempo.co rated the claim "Vaksin Covid-19 akan menanamkan microchip yang diprogram untuk membantai 7,5 miliar nyawa dan melakukan perbudakan global" as "Keliru" (False), stating that COVID-19 vaccines do not implant microchips for global enslavement.

evidence.title: COVID-19 Vaccines Don't Have Patient-Tracking Devices
evidence.snippet_en: FactCheck.org rated the claim "COVID-19 vaccines have a microchip that "tracks the location of the patient."" as "False", concluding that COVID-19 vaccines do not contain patient-tracking devices.

evidence.title: FDA-Approved ‘Electronic Pill’ Isn't Evidence That COVID-19 ...
evidence.snippet_en: FactCheck.org rated the claim "‘Another Conspiracy Proven True!’ referring to 2018 remarks by Pfizer CEO and claims about microchips in COVID-19 vaccines." as "False", stating that the Pfizer CEO's remarks were not about COVID-19 vaccine microchips.

evidence.title: Magnet Videos Refuel Bogus Claim of Vaccine Microchips
evidence.snippet_en: FactCheck.org rated the claim "Videos of magnets sticking to arms prove that the COVID-19 vaccines contain microchips." as "False", concluding that such videos do not prove microchips in vaccines.

evidence.title: Health Sensors Misconstrued as Government Tracking 'Microchips'
evidence.snippet_en: FactCheck.org rated the claim ""A new report from '60 Minutes' includes an interview with a scientist from the Pentagon who says that there is now a COVID microchip."" as "False", clarifying that health sensors were misconstrued as tracking microchips.

evidence.title: No, Government is not implanting microchips into human bodies ...
evidence.snippet_en: FACTLY rated the claim "The government is implanting microchips into human bodies through COVID-19 vaccine in order to take them under control" as "FALSE", concluding that the government is not implanting microchips via vaccines.

evidence.title: Hoax posts about microchips in Pfizer-BioNTech Covid-19 vaccine ...
evidence.snippet_en: AFP Fact Check rated the claim "Video of microchip found in Pfizer vaccine" as "Missing context", indicating that posts about microchips in Pfizer-BioNTech Covid-19 vaccine are hoaxes.

evidence.title: Spoof Video Furthers Microchip Conspiracy Theory
evidence.snippet_en: FactCheck.org rated the claim "A microchip reader for pets detected a chip in the arm of a woman vaccinated against COVID-19." as "False", concluding that the video was a spoof furthering a microchip conspiracy theory.

evidence.title: Fact check: COVID-19 vaccines don't contain tracking devices
evidence.snippet_en: USA Today rated the claim "COVID-19 vaccines contain microchips or other tracking devices, cause magnetic reaction" as "False", concluding that COVID-19 vaccines do not contain tracking devices.
